description: Create an Account/Subscription/Invoice/Payment/Product object with the given fields. Requires type and a non-empty fields object. This is a write action.
embedding_description: Create a new Zuora billing object (e.g. a new Account or Subscription) with the supplied field values. Requires type (one of Account, Subscription, Invoice, Payment, Product) and a non-empty fields object. A write action.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with id (the new object's id) and success (bool).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm creation and report the new object id; low sensitivity (id only, data_sensitivity 0.0).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing/unsupported type or an empty/missing fields object. zuora.validation_failed: a field value or combination was rejected. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.validation_failed: check required fields and valid values for that object type. zuora.invalid_params: type must be one of Account, Subscription, Invoice, Payment, Product.
